Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Zelo Grelor: 37-year-old woman, 168 cm (medium), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: broad oval face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: contrasting side length. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
